name: FUN_ADM_ATTRIBUTES_B
description: This table stores attributes from target and refeference objects that can be used in attribute derivation rule as both input and target attributtes to derive transaction attributes.  For example, derive business unit based on supplier on invoice or derive ledger based on legacy company.

columns.name: ATTRIBUTE_ID
columns.description: Unique sequence generated identifier for the attribute entry.

columns.name: ATTRIBUTE_CODE
columns.description: Short name of the attribute that uniquely identifies an attribute.

columns.name: ATTRIBUTE_GROUP_CODE
columns.description: Target attribute category such as enterprise attributes, tax attributes, project attribute, descriptive flexfield,  or global flexfield.

columns.name: DATATYPE_CODE
columns.description: Attribute data type. Possible values are C (alphanumeric), N (Numeric), or D (Date).

columns.name: VALUE_SET_CODE
columns.description: Value set associated with the attribute.

columns.name: VIEW_APPLICATION_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the application associated with the lookup type.

columns.name: LOOKUP_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Lookup associated with the attribute.

columns.name: KEY_FLEXFIELD_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the attribute stores any key flexfield.

columns.name: SEGMENT_CODE
columns.description: Accounting flexfield segment associated with the attribute.

columns.name: CODE_COMBINATION_ID
columns.description: Code combination identifier of a key flexfield attribute.

columns.name: FLEXFIELD_APPLICATION_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the application associated with the key flexfield.

columns.name: ID_FLEX_CODE
columns.description: Unique identifier of key flexfield.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: SEED_DATA_SOURCE
columns.description: Source of seed data record. A value of 'BULK_SEED_DATA_SCRIPT' indicates that record was bulk loaded. Otherwise, specifies the name of the seed data file.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET1
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET1. Context values are Y or N.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET2
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET2. Context values are Y or N.
